0. Load ETDA Trusted List (when a transaction needs it)

and DW Core in wp.txt as wallet provider (certificate for WUA signatures , location of the WUA status lists) | WUA = WIA and key attestation

not the trust failure reason of that step , as in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence
7. DW Core Resolves the Credential Offer (inside request 1.2)
[STANDARD] OpenID4VCI 1.0
• 13.4 (MUST NOT) sensitive data only through a fully trusted server part of the wallet
• 13.5 (MUST) the Wallet validates the Credential Issuer
• 13.10 (MUST) a stored Bearer access token is kept secure
[SPEC] DW Core is the fully trusted server part of the wallet , it holds the pre-authorized_code and the access token (stored encrypted , not logged , not sent to the app)
and makes every protocol call , the app signs and checks , the issuer trust check stays on the app
[SPEC] URLs from an offer or a QR are called only over https and never to internal addresses

secure local storage : Android EncryptedSharedPreferences / Room encrypted DB , iOS Keychain
envelope encryption : KEK in secure hardware protects DEK on disk , DEK encrypts the data files
file protection : unreadable while the screen is locked , not only until first unlock after boot
access : biometric / PIN / device unlock
personal data : no readable claim copies without justification
holder private key : Secure Enclave / Android Keystore / StrongBox , not exportable
usage policy : holder confirmation before presentation , holder signing before VP submission
